Handwriting track

• Detail stroke order, pressure patterns and any indications of autopen, cut-and-paste or digital overlay.

1. A single, court-ready report (PDF) that merges findings from both tracks, written in plain language with technical appendices.

Acceptance criteria  
• Procedures must follow NIST/ISO 17025 or comparable guidelines, with tool output traceable (e.g., EnCase, FTK, X-Ways, Cellebrite where applicable).

• Crear, formatear y actualizar documentos en Word y hojas de cálculo en Excel según indicaciones.

title: Accurate Handwritten Notes to PDF
desc:
I’m digitising several batches of handwritten notes and need them reproduced faithfully, then supplied back to me as clean, professionally formatted PDFs. The handwriting is straightforward—no technical jargon, formulae, or specialised symbols—so the focus is squarely on accuracy, layout consistency, and an error-free final file.

Besides straight typing, some pages will require light copy-paste transfers and re-formatting so the text aligns smoothly across paragraphs, headings, and any listed items. On a few legacy files I may also ask you to convert existing PDFs into editable Word documents so I can make quick edits before we lock the final version back down to PDF.  

I will provide high-resolution scans, page counts, and any style guidelines up front. You commit to:  
• Flawless transcription with spelling and punctuation intact  
• Consistent margins, fonts, and heading hierarchy  
• Timely delivery of each agreed batch in PDF format  

If you spot ambiguities in the handwriting, flag them early so we can clarify and keep momentum. Finished files should open perfectly in Adobe Acrobat without extra optimisation steps on my end.

Let me know your turnaround time per 20 pages and any tools you prefer for OCR, proofreading, or PDF production. Accuracy and punctuality are my top priorities; if those match your working style, this should be a smooth ongoing collaboration.

title: Commission-Only Cold Callers
desc:
I build conversion-focused websites for local businesses of every niche and I’m ready to scale. To do that, I need energetic cold callers who are happy to work strictly on commission and who know how to open doors with business owners over the phone.

Your job is simple: track down local companies that still rely on outdated or poorly performing sites (or have none at all), spark their interest in upgrading, explain the value of our done-for-you website service, and close the sale. I can supply a proven script, case-study material and a lightweight CRM, or you can lean on your own tools if you already have a system that works.

Commission is paid on every deal you personally bring in, with no caps. You’ll log call notes in the CRM so we both stay transparent on pipeline progress and so payouts are easy to verify. If you have prior success selling digital services by phone and the confidence to earn purely from the deals you land, let’s talk—there’s no limit on how much you can make here. COMMISSION ONLY

title: Translate Mystery Novel to German
desc:
I have a full-length English-language mystery/thriller novel that needs to come alive for German readers. The book relies heavily on atmosphere, tension and a web of subtle clues, plus it contains many location-specific cultural references and idiomatic turns of phrase that must feel natural to a German audience rather than forced or literal.

Your task is to deliver a fluent, engaging German manuscript that preserves:

• the pacing and suspense integral to the genre  
• each character’s unique voice and dialogue rhythms  
• the intent behind culturally loaded references—adapted where necessary so the meaning lands for German readers while staying faithful to the original plot

Deliverables  
1. Complete German translation in an editable Word document, mirroring the original chapter structure  
2. Brief translator’s notes highlighting any significant cultural or idiomatic adaptations  
3. One revision pass after my review to polish any remaining nuances

Please share examples of previous literary or mystery/thriller translations you have handled and your estimated timeline for a project of this scope. I look forward to collaborating with someone who can capture every twist and cliff-hanger in pitch-perfect German.

title: Actor Commercial & Theatrical Headshots
desc:
I need fresh, professional headshots that work for both commercial and theatrical submissions. I’m flexible on lighting—natural, studio, or a thoughtful mix—so long as the final images look flattering and industry-ready. A clean, plain-color backdrop keeps the focus on expression, so please plan for that setup.

Shoot goals  
• Capture distinct looks tailored for commercial (approachable, friendly) and theatrical (dramatic, comedic, character-driven) casting.  
• Provide coaching during the session to bring out authentic expressions.  
• Deliver at least 6 fully retouched selects in both high-resolution print format and optimized web copies, plus all usable proofs.

I’ll handle wardrobe; you bring the technical expertise, camera gear, and lighting that best achieves the brief. Turnaround of proofs within 48 hours and finals within a week would be ideal.

title: Blue-Collar Lead Generation Setup
desc:
I’m launching a UK-wide lead generation agency that will feed a steady stream of qualified enquiries to plumbers, electricians and landscapers. I already know the service I want to offer—pure lead generation—so I now need an experienced specialist who can turn that idea into a functioning, revenue-producing operation.

Here’s what I have in mind:
• Shape the overall strategy: define the buyer personas for each trade, map their typical customer journey and recommend the mix of channels most likely to deliver predictable results.
• Build the engine: set up the campaigns, tracking, automations and reporting dashboards so we can attribute every call, form fill or booking back to its source.
• Produce proof fast: deliver an initial batch of real-world leads we can hand to our first trade clients to validate the funnel.
• Document everything: provide a concise playbook I can follow to scale the process to new trades and regions.

You’re free to lean on social media ads, Google search, local SEO snippets, email outreach—or anything else you trust—provided it complies with UK advertising rules and delivers measurable, cost-effective leads.

If you’ve built high-performing funnels for UK trades before and can show verifiable results, I want to hear how you’d tackle this brief, the tools you’d use and the timeline you’d need to get the first leads rolling in.

title: Remote Job Market Research Assistant
desc:
I’m looking for a Virtual Assistant to help with online research and organization of remote technology job opportunities.

The goal of this project is to collect and organize relevant job market information for software engineering roles, including AI, backend, full-stack, cloud, and DevOps positions.

Responsibilities:

Identify roles that match specific technical skills and experience requirements.
Record job details including company name, position title, location, technology stack, salary information (when available), and job link.
Organize collected information in Notion, Google Sheets, or a similar tracking system.
Categorize opportunities by role type, technology requirements, and relevance.
Provide regular updates on research progress.

Experience with web research and data organization.
Strong attention to detail.
Ability to summarize job descriptions accurately.
Familiarity with technology roles is preferred.
Experience with Notion or Google Sheets is a plus.

Organized job research database.
Regular research updates.
Clearly categorized remote job opportunities.

title: Part-Time Multi-Field Assistant
desc:

Work may range from light administrative support to bits of customer interaction or simple graphic tweaks—whatever keeps the business moving smoothly that week. Because priorities shift, I value adaptability more than deep specialization; if you are comfortable learning on the fly and pick up new tools quickly, we’ll get along well.

Clear communication, dependable turnaround times, and good attention to detail are essential.

When you respond, let me know:
• Your time-zone and preferred working windows  
• Relevant software you already handle confidently

title: HR Assistant for Records & Payroll

title: KDP Guidance for Children’s Book

1. A step-by-step production plan tailored to my book.  
2. Polished, upload-ready files or proven formatting templates.

We can collaborate through recorded calls, shared docs in Google Drive, and screen-share walkthroughs inside KDP, Canva/InDesign, or any tools you recommend. If this sounds like work you’ve done for your own titles—or better yet, for other children’s authors—let’s talk details and schedule our first session.

title: Asistencia para empleo remoto

Busco apoyo integral para conseguir un trabajo de medio tiempo, 100 % remoto, en el área de atención al cliente. Ya cuento con experiencia previa atendiendo clientes; necesito ayuda para:

title: French Child Speech Consultant -- 2
desc:

All families you’ll meet are native French speakers, so every session—and all written feedback—must be in French.

Here’s how the collaboration works:

All development must be carried out in GX Works3, making full use of the motion instruction set and cam table utilities available for the iQ-F series. I already have the basic hardware topology and parameter files; what I need is a clean, well-structured program that:

• Generates and downloads the required rotational cam profiles.

• Handles start-up homing, cam engagement, on-the-fly ratio changes, and safe stop routines.  
• Includes concise comments and a short commissioning guide so I can adapt timings later.

Acceptance criteria: each slave axis must track the master within ±1 pulse at 2000 rpm when tested on a scope, and the project file must compile with no warnings in GX Works3.

Deliverables: GXW3 project file, exported cam tables (CSV or TXT), and a brief PDF explaining parameter settings, test procedure, and any user bits required for HMI control.
